The function shall put the controller in the specified mode given in the parameter 'CtrlMode': • Upon mode ETH_MODE_DOWN the driver shall:  Disable Tx/Rx communication of the Ethernet controller  Reset all transmit and receive buffers (i.e. ignore all pending transmission and reception requests) • Upon mode ETH_MODE_ACTIVE:  Enable all transmit and receive buffers  Activate Rx/Tx communication of the Ethernet controller
